title: Project Brief
summary: Turn the initial idea into an agreed project boundary.

title: Module Map
summary: Identify permanent system ownership before planning implementation.

title: Module Requirements
summary: Define one module's responsibilities, inputs, outputs and constraints.

title: Slice Specification
summary: Describe a temporary, testable unit of work across module boundaries.

title: Task List
summary: Convert an approved slice into ordered, verifiable actions.

title: Documentation Audit
summary: Check that the plan is complete enough to implement safely.

title: Implementation Session
summary: Start bounded implementation with the right context and controls.

title: Test Plan
summary: Translate requirements into observable checks and evidence.

title: Controlled Revision
summary: Assess and apply a change without losing approved intent.

title: Experience Review
summary: Challenge whether the intended player experience is coherent.

title: Handoff and Resume
summary: Capture current state so work can restart without reconstruction.

title: Recovery
summary: Diagnose drift or failure and return to the last trusted state.
